assumptions: The ESM-2 model and scoring strategy named, as facebookresearch/esm's predict.py computes it.
limits: A zero-shot likelihood, not a measured effect.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the model's per-variant score, which the outputs carry; no panel shows this tool, so there is no panel reading to carry.
bio.jane/contract.question: How much less (or more) likely does ESM-2 find each substitution than the wild-type residue?

description: Score protein substitutions with ESM-2, the zero-shot way `facebookresearch/esm`'s own `predict.py` does: how much less (or more) likely the mutant residue is than the wild type at that site, under a protein language model. It ranks a saturation library without an assay — and it is a RANKING IN NATS, not a stability measurement: it carries no kcal/mol and is calibrated against nothing. THE MODEL IS DOWNLOADED ON FIRST RUN, 30 MB for the 8M export and 2.6 GB for the 650M one, then cached; a run in a browser with no network to Hugging Face will refuse rather than hang.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

model.description: which published ESM-2 ONNX export to score under. The three sizes are a download decision as much as an accuracy one, and the label says which. Values: esm2_t6_8M (ESM-2 8M · 30.3 MB), esm2_t12_35M (ESM-2 35M · 134.5 MB), esm2_t33_650M (ESM-2 650M · 2.61 GB).

offset_idx.description: the number `position` counts from. 1 is ordinary protein numbering; set it when your variants are numbered against a mature chain or a construct that starts partway in. Advanced.

protein.description: the protein the positions are numbered against, one letter per residue. Wire a translation, or the CDS protein the library was designed on — the positions mean nothing without it.

strategy.description: how the score is computed. `masked-marginals` is ESM-1v's recommendation — one forward pass per residue, each with that site masked. `wt-marginals` is one pass over the wild type and the paper reports it as weaker. `pseudo-ppl` scores the whole mutant sequence and costs one pass per residue PER VARIANT, which is two orders of magnitude more; its number is a log-likelihood, not a ratio, and is comparable only against other variants of the same protein. Values: wt-marginals (Wild-type marginals), masked-marginals (Masked marginals), pseudo-ppl (Pseudo-perplexity).

variants.description: the substitutions, in `A24D` form: wild-type residue, position, mutant residue. Every one is checked against `protein` first, because a scored substitution whose wild type does not match is a confident number about a protein nobody has.

name: score_variant_effect

caption.description: the one sentence a score may never be shown without, generated from THIS run rather than fixed: what the number means under the strategy that produced it, and what it is not

leastDamaging.description: the highest-scoring substitution — the one the model finds most ordinary

model.description: which ESM-2 export produced these scores. Scores from two models are not comparable

mostDamaging.description: the lowest-scoring substitution. It is the model's opinion about likelihood, not a measured loss of function, and `caption` is the sentence that says so

passes.description: forward passes the run cost — the price of the strategy, after the fact

ranked.description: just the substitution notations, in the same order — the list to take forward into an order or a filter

scores.description: every variant with its score in nats, the strategy that produced it and the forward passes it cost — MOST DAMAGING FIRST, which is the reason to rank a library at all

strategy.description: which of the three strategies ran. Scores from two strategies are not comparable either, and pseudo-perplexity is not even the same quantity
